buy: cash_delta=-gross*fill; position_delta=gross*(1-fee_rate); fee_amount=gross*fee_rate in BASE; fee_USDT_mid=fee_amount*mid
sell: gross<=actual_net_held; cash_delta=gross*fill*(1-fee_rate); position_delta=-gross; fee_amount=gross*fill*fee_rate in USDT
gross_shadow: Same NET_RECEIVED position deltas; shadowcash-=position_delta*mid. GrossshadowNAV-netNAV equals cumulative fill-time fee_USDT_mid plus gross execution_cost
dust: Gross sell quantity floored to order lot and never exceeds actual net holdings; positive sublot inventory remains marked, no dust threshold deletion
cycle: Buy cycle cost is spent notional only; sell proceeds are received notional less quote fee; informational fee_mid is never charged a second time
preserved_engine_capabilities: Original timing, capacity, risk windows, holding policy, pending/expiry/retry, orders, marking, summary and target format
derivation_guards: Hard source SHA and exact unique AST anchors; separate globals; exported converted AST and hash; no legacy mutation
